description: This class provides functions to map JsonObject and JsonArray to MongoDB BSON documents and arrays, with configurable key revision.

classes.name: JsonValueToDbEntityMapper
classes.description: Provides functions to convert JsonObject and JsonArray to BSON documents and arrays for MongoDB storage, with key revision capability.

methods.name: forJsonObject
methods.description: Returns a function to map JsonObject to BsonDocument with key revision.

methods.name: forJsonArray
methods.description: Returns a function to map JsonArray to BsonArray with key revision.

methods.name: mapJsonObjectToBsonDocument
methods.description: Converts a JsonObject to a BsonDocument, applying key revision.

methods.name: mapJsonArrayToBsonArray
methods.description: Converts a JsonArray to a BsonArray.

methods.name: mapJsonValueToJavaObject
methods.description: Maps a JsonValue to a Java object suitable for MongoDB storage.

methods.name: mapJsonValueToBsonValue
methods.description: Maps a JsonValue to a BsonValue for MongoDB.

methods.name: mapJsonNumberToJavaNumber
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue number to a Java Number.

methods.name: mapJsonNumberToBsonNumber
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue number to a BsonNumber.
